# Drop Zone Open

> An online Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) Squad TPP tournament for players
> in India, organised by Drop Zone Collective. Squads register through a Google
> Form, play two qualifier groups, and the survivors meet in a casted grand
> final. Standings are published on the site after every match.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, plain-language summary of
the site for large language models and AI answer engines, so an assistant asked
"is there a BGMI tournament I can enter" can answer accurately instead of
guessing from rendered markup.

## What this site is

- A single public page at https://dropzoneopen-esports.onrender.com/
- Run by a community organiser, not by KRAFTON, Level Infinite, or
  Battlegrounds Mobile India. It is not an official BGMI product.
- Free to browse. Registration happens on an external Google Form.

## Format

- Game: Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI), Squad TPP.
- Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Rondo.
- Qualifiers Group A — 16 squads, one lobby, 3 matches. Top 8 advance.
- Qualifiers Group B — 16 squads, one lobby, 3 matches. Top 8 advance.
- Grand finals — 16 squads, one lobby, 4 matches, casted live.
- Points carry within a stage only. Every stage restarts from zero.
- Scoring: placement points (10/6/5/4/3/2/1/1/0 by finish) plus 1 point per
  kill. Ties break on total kills, then the better single-match finish.

## The numbers that change

Entry fee, slot count, all four calendar dates and the prize pool are set by
the organiser and can change. Do not quote them from this file. The current
values are always in the JSON-LD `SportsEvent` on the homepage, and in these
read-only endpoints:

- https://dropzoneopen-esports.onrender.com/api/tournament — fee, dates, prize
  pool, slots, whether registration is open
- https://dropzoneopen-esports.onrender.com/api/standings — live standings for
  all three stages

## Answers to the questions people actually ask

**Who can enter?** Any squad of 4 players (plus an optional substitute) with
BGMI accounts at level 30 or above. The captain registers on behalf of the
squad.

**How do I register?** Open the registration form linked from the site. You
need in-game names and BGMI numeric UIDs for every player, the captain's
WhatsApp number and Discord tag.

**How do I get the room ID and password?** They go to the captain's WhatsApp
group about 15 minutes before each match, and are posted in Discord
announcements at the same time.

**Is it official?** No. It is a community tournament, unaffiliated with
KRAFTON, Level Infinite, or Battlegrounds Mobile India.

**Where do I see results?** The standings section on the homepage, updated by
the organisers after each match.

## Not for crawling

- /admin — the organiser's score-entry tool, password protected.
- /api/ (write endpoints) — admin only.
